description: This file defines Django view functions for the 'jwql' web application, specifically for instrument monitor pages such as bad pixel, bias, dark, and readnoise monitors. It imports Django's render function, utility modules, and container functions to generate web page content based on instrument names.

methods.name: bad_pixel_monitor
methods.description: Generates the bad pixel monitor page for a specified JWST instrument, returning a rendered HTML page with appropriate context.

methods.name: bias_monitor
methods.description: Generates the bias monitor page for a specified JWST instrument, returning a rendered HTML page with appropriate context.

methods.description: Generates the dark monitor page for a specified JWST instrument, returning a rendered HTML page with appropriate context.
